scripts.title: Windows Settings App Configurations
scripts.description: Configures AutoPlay, Telemetry, Delivery Optimization, Developer Mode, Lock Screen Notifications, and Clipboard security settings.

options.name: DeliveryOptimizationMode
options.description: Delivery Optimization peer download sharing mode

scripts.title: Control Panel
scripts.description: Hardens Control Panel baselines: sets UAC to maximum ('Always Notify') and enables Windows Defender Firewall across Domain, Private, and Public profiles with inbound blocked by default.

scripts.title: Local Security Policy (secpol.msc & gpedit.msc)
scripts.description: Enforces Account Password/Lockout Policies, comprehensive Success/Failure Advanced Audit Policies, User Rights Assignment, and Security Options.

scripts.title: Local Users and Groups (lusrmgr.msc)
scripts.description: Audits local accounts, disables built-in Guest and default Administrator, removes unauthorized users from Administrators group, and clears PasswordNeverExpires flag.

scripts.title: Computer Management
scripts.description: Removes unauthorized file shares, audits unneeded services, and expands Security, System, and Application Event Log maximum sizes.

scripts.title: Windows Security & Threat Protection
scripts.description: Enables Windows Defender Real-Time Protection, Cloud Delivery, Tamper Protection, Potentially Unwanted App (PUA) blocking, and updates signatures.

scripts.title: Task Manager
scripts.description: Audits startup applications, checks RUN registry keys for rogue persistence, and flags suspicious background processes.

scripts.title: Task Scheduler (taskschd.msc)
scripts.description: Audits scheduled tasks for reverse shells, netcat, unauthorized binaries, and suspicious script arguments.

scripts.title: Registry Editor (regedit.exe)
scripts.description: Enforces critical system registry hardening: RunAsPPL LSA protection against credential dumping, SafeDllSearchMode, AutoRun disable, and screensaver timeout.

scripts.title: Command Prompt & PowerShell Security Commands
scripts.description: Enforces PowerShell ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned, enables Deep Script Block Logging, Module Logging, and Transcription.

scripts.title: File System, Drive Security & Prohibited Media Files
scripts.description: Scans drives for prohibited media files (mp3, mp4, avi, wav, etc.), audits sensitive file NTFS permissions, and checks hidden directories.

options.name: SystemRepair
options.description: System file integrity repair

scripts.title: Server Roles & Windows Features Framework
scripts.description: Disables insecure/legacy Windows features (SMB1, Telnet, TFTP, Simple TCP/IP, FTP, IIS, Internet Printing, WSL, Sandbox) and removes unneeded Server roles.

options.name: KeepIIS
options.description: Keep IIS on Windows 10/11 (this machine is a designated web server)

options.name: KeepADDS
options.description: Keep Active Directory Domain Services (this machine is a domain controller)

options.name: KeepDHCP
options.description: Keep the DHCP Server role (Windows Server only)

options.name: KeepRDS
options.description: Keep Remote Desktop Services roles (Windows Server only)

options.name: KeepADCS
options.description: Keep Active Directory Certificate Services roles (Windows Server only)

options.name: KeepVirtualPlatform
options.description: Keep Virtual Machine Platform (needed if Credential Guard is instructed)

options.name: KeepFTP
options.description: Keep all FTP features (IIS FTP Server, TFTP Client) and the IIS role

scripts.title: SMB & Windows File Sharing
scripts.description: Hardens SMB: encryption, signing, anonymous access, NTLM/LM settings, SMBGhost, SMB firewall profiles; closes open SMB sessions and lists non-default shares for README review.

options.name: SMBCompression
options.description: SMB compression state (SMBGhost mitigation when Disabled)

scripts.title: Remote Desktop Services (RDP)
scripts.description: Sets RDP state, requires NLA, enforces High encryption/SSL, idle and disconnect time limits, Restricted Admin, blocks drive/COM/LPT redirection, disables Remote Assistance, and configures RDP services and firewall.

options.name: RDPState
options.description: Remote Desktop feature state

scripts.title: Web Browsers
scripts.description: Hardens Chrome, Firefox and Edge via policy keys, updates the selected browser, removes all other browsers, and optionally manages Internet Explorer on legacy systems.

options.name: Browser
options.description: Browser to keep and update; all other browsers are removed

options.name: InternetExplorerState
options.description: Internet Explorer 11 feature state (Windows 10/Server only; ignored on Windows 11)

scripts.title: Web Servers (IIS, Apache)
scripts.description: Hardens IIS and Apache: bindings, logging, default content, authentication, request filtering, security headers, permissions and auditing. Optionally keeps either web server running.

options.name: IISState
options.description: IIS (W3SVC): Disabled stops and disables it; Enabled keeps it running and hardens it

options.name: ApacheState
options.description: Apache (C:\Apache24): Disabled stops and disables it; Enabled keeps it running and hardens httpd.conf

scripts.title: Database Servers (SQL Server & MariaDB / MySQL)
scripts.description: Hardens SQL Server (protocols, encryption, auditing, xp_cmdshell, OLE Automation, remote access, Database Mail, sysadmin, guest, sample DBs, NTFS ACLs) and MariaDB/MySQL (test DB, root, my.ini).

options.name: NamedPipesState
options.description: SQL Server Named Pipes protocol

options.name: SharedMemoryState
options.description: SQL Server Shared Memory protocol

options.name: SqlBrowserState
options.description: SQL Server Browser service (UDP 1434)

options.name: ClrState
options.description: SQL Server CLR integration

scripts.title: Remote Administration & Management
scripts.description: Disables WinRM Basic auth and unencrypted traffic, clears WinRM TrustedHosts, and sets WinRM/PowerShell Remoting and Remote Registry state.

options.name: WinRMState
options.description: WinRM / PowerShell Remoting state

options.name: RemoteRegistryState
options.description: Remote Registry service state

scripts.title: Email & Messaging Servers (SMTP)
scripts.description: Disables SMTP and blocks TCP 25, or hardens SMTP (relay restrictions, no anonymous auth, TLS, W3C logging, VRFY/EXPN off, BadMail relocated) when the scenario requires it.

options.name: SMTPState
options.description: Whether the scenario requires an SMTP server (check the README)

scripts.title: Network Services & Legacy Protocols
scripts.description: Disables FTP, Telnet, SNMP Trap, SimpleTCP, UPnP/SSDP, RIP, RPC Locator, ICS, Remote Registry, Computer Browser, RRAS, W3SVC, Xbox, Bluetooth, Maps and RDP port redirector services; keeps vital services running.

options.name: WebServerState
options.description: World Wide Web Publishing Service (W3SVC) - enable only if this is a required web server

options.name: SnmpTrapState
options.description: SNMP Trap service (SNMPTRAP) - enable only if README requires SNMP

options.name: UpnpState
options.description: UPnP Device Host and SSDP Discovery (upnphost, SSDPSRV)

options.name: BluetoothState
options.description: Bluetooth Support Service (bthserv)

options.name: RdpRedirectorState
options.description: Remote Desktop Services UserMode Port Redirector (UmRdpService) - enable if RDP device redirection is required

scripts.title: Network Stack & Name Resolution
scripts.description: Hardens the TCP/IP stack (SYN flood, ICMP redirects, source routing, router discovery), applies the Microsoft-supported IPv6 hardening (prefer IPv4, disable tunnels), and disables NetBIOS over TCP/IP, LLMNR/mDNS, and the WPAD auto-discovery service.

options.name: Ipv6State
options.description: BasicDisabled: keep IPv6 on, prefer IPv4, disable tunnels (MS-supported) | Enabled: Windows default | GloballyDisabled: unbind IPv6 + DisabledComponents=0xFF (unsupported)

options.name: NetBiosState
options.description: NetBIOS over TCP/IP on adapters and the TCP/IP NetBIOS Helper service (lmhosts)

options.name: MulticastNameResolutionState
options.description: LLMNR and mDNS multicast name resolution

options.name: WpadServiceState
options.description: WinHTTP Web Proxy Auto-Discovery Service (WinHttpAutoProxySvc)

scripts.title: Active Directory Domain Services & GPMC
scripts.description: Domain Controllers only: enforces domain password/lockout policy and DC auditing, requires Kerberos preauthentication, hardens SPN accounts, resets krbtgt twice, and optionally enables the AD Recycle Bin.

options.name: EnableRecycleBin
options.description: Enable the AD Recycle Bin (irreversible once enabled)

scripts.title: Print Spooler & Printer Drivers
scripts.description: Blocks PrintNightmare vectors, restricts printer driver and Point and Print installs to admins, and disables the Print Spooler service by default.

options.name: SpoolerState
options.description: Print Spooler service state (Enabled only if printing is required)

options.name: AllowRemotePrinting
options.description: Accept inbound remote print connections (only for a dedicated print server)
